about: Witches' jelly flats: the swamp board scan rebuilt as one grounded diorama. Front (+X, toward the road): mud bog and plank puddle; middle: slime ditch row and overgrowth; back: dead birch grove and petrified trees. Swatch cards and wireframe previews are left out. Apply with agentic-tooling media/glb-components/glb_components.py compose.
